verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents a public REST API with an OpenAPI specification, which a probe confirms is live at /openapi.json. It also offers an `@lobehub/sdk` generated from that spec and a CLI to operate an existing instance from a terminal. Nothing shows the API covers everything the UI can do, such as Tasks, Pages, scheduling, agent building, memory or workspace management. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity or a coverage statement, endpoint-level evidence for major UI features (tasks, pages, scheduled tasks, agent teams, memory), and independent or hands-on corroboration of API completeness.
